units.headline: Adds 5-minute TTL for cached record lookup failures
units.summary: Adds errorCacheTTL = 5m. GetRecord uses it to suppress repeat lookups after a failure. The comment says permanent FORBIDDEN errors are the reason, but every error type gets cached.
focus: Whether a 5-minute negative cache is acceptable for transient errors
units.reason: The TTL value sets how long lookups are suppressed after a failure.

units.headline: New struct pairing a cached error with its expiry time
units.summary: An internal struct holding an error and its expiry time. It does nothing by itself.
units.reason: Unexported data holder; its behavior comes from GetRecord.

units.headline: Client gains an error cache map and injectable get/now funcs
units.summary: Adds an errors map plus test hooks for get and now. Like the existing cache map, the errors map has no lock protecting it.
focus: Whether the Client is used from multiple goroutines; neither map has a lock
units.reason: Struct field changes add new shared mutable state.

units.headline: NewClient initializes the error map and default get/now hooks
units.summary: Sets up the errors map, uses time.Now as the clock, and points get at fetchFromServer. Simple wiring.
units.reason: Plain initialization of the new fields.

units.headline: GetRecord caches every lookup failure per key for 5 minutes
units.summary: Drops the retry parameter. Any error from get is now cached per key for errorCacheTTL and returned on later calls without contacting the server, including transient errors such as timeouts and context cancellations.
focus: Transient errors like timeouts and resets are negatively cached
Errors caused by the caller's own context are cached for other callers
Callers whose signature changed because the retry parameter was removed

issues.title: Transient and context errors cached for five minutes
issues.failure_scenario: One request hits the 1s timeout or has its context cancelled, so Get returns context.DeadlineExceeded. That key then fails for 5 minutes for every caller, even though the server is healthy.

units.reason: Changes error handling and retry behavior for every inventory lookup.

units.headline: Fetch reconnects once, except when the server sends an error reply
units.summary: Moves the connect and single-retry logic out of GetRecord. The new part is that it no longer reconnects after a ReplyError.
focus: Whether ReplyError is returned as a value or a pointer, so errors.As matches it
units.reason: Changes retry and reconnect behavior.

units.headline: Helper that detects a ReplyError with errors.As
units.summary: A small helper with test coverage. It matches only the value type ReplyError.
units.reason: Trivial helper whose effect is judged in fetchFromServer.

units.headline: Call site updated for GetRecord without the retry argument
units.summary: Drops the retry argument. Retrying now happens inside fetchFromServer.
units.reason: Mechanical call-site update.
